findings.reason: the plan states a guard exists that does not, so §3's justification and any test written against it would assert a refusal the grammar never performs, when the real guard is §2's membership assertion.
findings.text: §3 says `source` "collides with the physical base `source` that the grammar's uniqueness test forbids in a second segment", but the only cross-registry uniqueness test, `_no_duplicate_names_across_registries` (`imas_standard_names/grammar/vocab_loaders.py:536`), validates five pools only — `coordinate_axes`, `locus_registry`, `operators`, `physical_bases`, `geometry_carriers` — and `qualifiers.yml` is not one of them; there is no other qualifier-versus-base duplicate guard in the package. The carve-out is still right (a `source` qualifier would compete with the bases `source` and `source_rate` at `physical_bases.yml:423`), and the enforcement §2 actually specifies is its explicit membership test — so the cited mechanism is the wrong one and a worker checking it would find no such test firing

findings.reason: §5's third done-when arm (an absent-target issue when the coordinate has no entry) has no mechanism behind it, so the worker would add a parse-to-index reference path or discover the reuse claim false mid-build, which is exactly the mechanism the plan says it is reusing.
findings.text: §5 says "the absent-target report of `_check_referential_integrity` covers a coordinate with no catalog entry", but that check resolves only `links`, `deprecates`, `superseded_by`, `arguments` names, `error_variants` and inline markdown references (`validation/semantic.py:149`); an indexed operator's coordinate is fused into the operator token, not carried as an argument — I parsed `derivative_of_deposited_power_with_respect_to_normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate` at `d88e5be` and the IR is `operators[0].op='derivative_with_respect_to_normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate'` with `args=[]` — so nothing in the existing check walks the index

rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §3's artifact lands at `docs/evidence/fragments/dd-gap-vocabulary/`, inside the repository and durable; §2 and §5's evidence is test assertions in the suite rather than a scratchpad path.
